articles.title: ESMA seeks evidence tokenized collateral can be cashed out in crisis
articles.description: ESMA is seeking industry feedback on the legal, liquidity and operational risks of tokenized collateral before deciding whether additional EU regulatory measures are necessary.

articles.title: Delta Air Lines cuts 2026 forecast on fuel surge, but CEO says demand is still strong
articles.description: Delta Air Lines reported third-quarter earnings and missed Wall Street estimates for the first time in two years.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies near $82,500 after Trump rules out Iran strike before midterms
articles.description: Bitcoin recovered to around $82,500 after Trump ruled out an Iran strike, but remains about 4% lower on the week, while ether has lost 9%.

articles.title: India calls JD Vance's comments about immigrants 'deeply offensive'
articles.description: India calls comments of U.S. Vice President J.D. Vance about immigrants from the country "deeply offensive."

articles.title: Pilot killed in attacks by Iran-backed Houthis on Riyadh airport; Saudi-led coalition vows 'firm' response
articles.description: Two attacks were launched on Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport Thursday, officials said.

articles.title: UK sanctions three crypto exchanges tied to Russian illicit funds
articles.description: The UK sanctioned crypto exchanges and payment processors, some of which were tied to thousands of Russian entities and the sanctioned HTX exchange.

articles.title: Thailand opens door to locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs
articles.description: Thailand’s new crypto rules taking effect Oct. 16. They allow Thai asset managers to launch crypto ETFs on the local stock exchange, with bitcoin and ether initially eligible.

articles.title: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill
articles.description: France’s Finance Committee backed taxes on stablecoin swaps, as well as unrealized crypto gains when households with more than 800,000 euros move abroad.

articles.title: UK slaps sanctions on three crypto exchanges over alleged Russia links
articles.description: Britain said the crypto platforms and two payment services may have helped Russia evade financial sanctions, with two handling transactions involving the Kremlin-backed A7 network.

articles.title: South Africa lawyer 'Navi' Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize for efforts to prosecute war crimes, genocide
articles.description: Navanethem "Navi" Pillay was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize on Friday for her work promoting peace and international law.

articles.title: OpenAI defends decision to fire researchers: 'These decisions were not about raising safety concerns or speaking out'
articles.description: OpenAI has defended its decision to fire three safety researchers for what the AI lab has described as a "significant breach of trust"

articles.title: Empire Market Co-Creator Sentenced to 40 Years Over $430M Dark Web Bazaar
articles.description: Raheim Hamilton forfeited some 1,230 BTC. His co-creator Thomas Pavey, who agreed to forfeit 1,584 BTC, is due to be sentenced this month.

articles.title: Bitcoin speculators move 55K BTC to exchanges amid $1.1B liquidations
articles.description: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000, sparking mass crypto liquidations as traders sent BTC to exchanges at a loss.

articles.title: Dark web drug market operator sentenced to 40 years, forfeits $101 million in bitcoin
articles.description: A man from Virginia, who facilitated millions of drug transactions worth roughly $430 million, agreed to give up $100 million worth of BTC. His partner forfeited nearly 1,600 BTC.

articles.title: MARA transfers $81.1 million in bitcoin to Galaxy Digital as strategy pivots to AI
articles.description: The bitcoin miner’s transfer does not confirm a sale, but comes as its treasury has fallen from 53,822 BTC in February to 35,577 BTC in August.

articles.title: Sam Altman-backed bitcoin insurer Meanwhile secures $37.5 million in Bain Capital Crypto-led round
articles.description: Meanwhile has signed 15 brokers serving high-net worth clients across markets iSwitzerland, Singapore, Hong Kong and the UAE.

articles.title: SIM-Swap Fraudster Who Spent Stolen Crypto on Gold Grills and Dubai Trips Jailed
articles.description: Ajay Shinjin helped steal nearly $265,000 in crypto after criminals hijacked BT customers' phone numbers in November 2021.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs’ October outflows swell toward $1B
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs lost $244 million on Thursday, while Ether funds extended their outflow streak to eight sessions, shedding $641 million.

articles.title: Live updates: XRP ETFs the only ones in green as BTC, ETH, ZEC funds post outflows
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs lost $244 million on Thursday and the ZEC fund extended a run of October outflows. Bitcoin is back near $82,000 after a $1 billion liquidation.

articles.title: New tech to power bitcoin lending is set to debut with $500 million in commitments
articles.description: Layer-1 blockchain Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol allowing holders to use bitcoin as collateral without moving it off the Bitcoin network.
